inputs.utterance: create a calc to change Status to numeric values

calculatedFieldFormula.formula: CASE [Task Status] WHEN 'Cancel' THEN 1 WHEN 'Not Started' THEN 2 WHEN 'Closed' THEN 3 WHEN 'Deferred' THEN 4 WHEN 'Approved' THEN 5 WHEN 'Completed' THEN 6 WHEN 'In Progress' THEN 7 WHEN 'Rejected' THEN 8 ELSE 0 END
